bio.text: Carmela Conroy, a Democrat, advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for Washington's 5th Congressional District.

According to Ballotpedia, she was born in Spokane, graduated from Central Valley High School, and earned a bachelor's degree and a law degree from the University of Washington and a graduate degree from the U.S. Naval War College in 2004.

Her campaign website says she worked as a Spokane County deputy prosecutor and later served in the U.S. Foreign Service, with postings in Afghanistan, Japan, New Zealand, Norway, Pakistan and Washington, D.C.

sources.title: More problem-solving, less politics - Carmela Conroy for Congress
